text:
maya: proposal — implement region-affinity + active latency probes for hosted API routing. goal: pick the lowest-latency region that has capacity for this customer tier, but prefer affinity when within SLO. sketch attached below.

alex: sgtm in principle. curious how probes interact with KV cache locality and prefix caching. if we switch regions mid-conversation we could lose warm KV.

ravi: +1 on probe idea but we need a probe budget. probes per-customer add cost. propose default sample 1% of requests for a short TCP+TLS RTT + handshake + first-token microprobe.

katie: product note — enterprise customers will want region pinning for compliance. routing should respect customer-managed region pin if set. otherwise use affinity+latency.

olivier: small API debate: expose `x-region-hint` header for SDKs to request a preferred region? or keep it internal and only surface via console? exposing header gives customers control but complicates SLOs.

maya: thinking: default behavior = affinity window (last-region used for that customer) for 90s staleness. if probe shows > p95_latency_threshold, shift to best region. customer-tier overrides: "enterprise_pin", then "dedicated_pool", then affinity+probe.

alex: can we handle model variant fallback in same mechanism? e.g., if preferred region lacks full-precision model, fallback to quantized variant in-region, or remote full-precision in another region. need priority rules.

maya: yes — policy model: region -> model_variant -> capacity_tier. fallback chain example: same-region fp32 -> same-region int8 -> remote-region fp32 (if latency penalty < 200ms) -> remote-region int8. penalty threshold per-customer tier.

ravi: telemetry requirements: emit `route_decision` spans that include: origin_probe_rtt, chosen_region, fallback_reason, model_variant, estimated_cost_delta. we'll need a Grafana panel.

alex: sample policy YAML (very rough):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  affinity_window_secs: 90
  probe:
    sample_rate: 0.01
    timeout_ms: 120
  tiers:
    enterprise:
      region_pin: true
      max_remote_penalty_ms: 150
    standard:
      region_pin: false
      max_remote_penalty_ms: 250
  model_fallback_priority:
    - same_region_fp32
    - same_region_int8
    - remote_region_fp32
    - remote_region_int8
```

katie: UX: in the Console routing page we should show a small matrix: for each customer -> preferred_region, last_probe_ts, last_probe_rtt (p50/p95), current_variant, fallback_count. clickable traces.

olivier: internal API: we should avoid adding extra headers by default. prefer server-side selection and only let SDK opt-in with `x-region-preference`. also need a flag to force remote fallback for debugging.

maya: edge cases: 1) sudden regional outage, must immediately divert to remote region and mark affinity as stale 2) in-flight chats: we should try to keep session-to-session consistency — maybe pin current conversation to chosen region until conversation end or TTL.

ravi: operationally: add alert if probe success rate drops below 95% or if route-switch rate exceeds baseline by 3x. also metric `kv_warm_miss_rate` post-switch.

alex: question — do we want active probes to use real model tokens (cheap microprobe prompt) or synthetic handshake-only probes? real microprobe can measure full-stack latency but costs tokens. handshake probes cheaper but miss model-init/compilation time.

maya: prefer hybrid: handshake probe for high-frequency sampling + occasional microprobe (every N minutes) to capture model cold-start. mark probe_type in telemetry.

katie: for rollout UX: canary the new routing policy for 5% of traffic overall, then 50% for non-enterprise, monitor p95/accuracy/regressions before full rollout. add a console toggle to opt-out account-by-account.

olivier: minor API detail: if customer sets `region_pin`, we must still provide clear errors when capacity is exhausted. do not silently route them elsewhere. return 429 with `x-allowed-regions` or provide explicit option to failover.

maya: next steps: write RFC with policy YAML, telemetry spec, console mockups, and rollout plan. i'll draft today. can folks take ownership of sections? olivier - API bits, ravi - telemetry/alerts, alex - KV/consistency risks, katie - console/rollout UX.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-prober v0.2 -> staging at 1767004600 :rocket:

alex: thanks — i'll start an integration spike for KV warming behavior.

ravi: i'll sketch Grafana panels and SLOs.

katie: i'll add the console mockups to the RFC doc.
